metadata.matched_init: every LR/budget cell of a (seed, reader, history) uses the same deterministic init seed `aw.reader_seed(seed, reader, 'op_dest', rep, top, 'main')`; only LR and the update budget change between cells
metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. The two readers are analysis-only, fit on Z/Y's exact fixed 256-transition subset, tuned on Y's canonical VAL, evaluated once on Y's untouched canonical TEST. Selection is VAL-only; the best-on-TRAIN state is diagnostic; TEST is never used to select LR/budget/reader/history.

primary_decision.rule_note: AA-INVALID if audit/invariant/control fails (control = GRU robust at both histories for some recipe); else AA-A if some recipe is robust at BOTH histories; else AA-MIX if some recipe is robust at exactly one history or reaches mean>=0.90 without the 4/5-seed criterion; else AA-B. Robust = five-seed mean max-train acc >=0.90 AND >=4/5 seeds >=0.90.
